paragraphs.text: # dsh-prompt-spark

One-click draft rewriting inside the **DeepSeek Harness** composer: a sparkle
button next to the inp

ut toolbar turns a rough draft into a clear message, with
instant undo. No settings page, no config
file — the useful choices are gestures.
## What it does

- **Rewrite** — click the sparkle to rewrite the draft more clearly with the
modeling route the curr

ent session already uses. The rewritten text replaces
the draft.
- **Undo** — after a rewrite the bu

tton becomes **undo**. It is offered only
while the draft is still exactly the rewritten text; edit

the draft and the
button returns to the sparkle.
- **Styles** — long-press or right-click the button

embered for the next click.
- **Selection rewrite** — select part of the draft before clicking and o

nly that
fragment is rewritten; the surrounding text is sent as context so the result
keeps its flow

.
- **Keyboard** — `Ctrl+Shift+O` (`Cmd+Shift+O` on macOS) in DSH Desktop, or
`Ctrl+Alt+Shift+O` on

the Web build; both are remappable in the built-in
Keyboard shortcuts panel. (Web reserves Ctrl+Shif

t+O for the official
"open in app" command, so the Web default adds Alt.)

The control hides itself when the draft is empty/whitespace or the composer is
busy (`adjudicating`

/ `submitting`), and failures leave the draft untouched
while the button tooltip reports the reason

bmitting`), and failures leave the draft untouched
while the button tooltip reports the reason code.

## How it works
| File | Role |
| `package.json` | npm bundle: `dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`, `dsh.client.platform: web` →

`client.js` |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | one `insert` row whose `name` is this package |
| `index.js` |
host half: `inject = ['webServer','connection']`, exact `POST /dsh-prompt-spark/rewrite` behind the

Connection trust fence, bounded body, `llm.stream` call |
| `client.js` | browser half: `window.__M

oduleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` returning `{ inject: ['slots','locale'], apply(ctx) }` |
| `loc
ale/*.json` | plugin-page display metadata |

The browser resolves the route relative to the document
(`new URL('dsh-prompt-spark/rewrite', docume

nt.baseURI)`), so a mounted prefix
works. The host never touches provider keys or endpoints: it stre

ams through the
composition's `llm` service with the session's own provider/model (falling back
to t

he configured default). Styles are fixed instruction suffixes; there is no
configuration surface at

onfigured default). Styles are fixed instruction suffixes; there is no
configuration surface at all.
